scope: 独立只读 GLB 地面审计；新铺装方案是展示设计，不是现状入口、地籍、无障碍设施或测绘认证。最终生成网格、外围源道路与水体相交检查由实施/独立复核另记。

sourceFrame.axis: glTF Y-up; source XZ plan coordinates
sourceFrame.units: 源建模单位，非测量米制
sourceFrame.runtimeTransform: subtract frozen normalizationOrigin; uniformScale; rotate Y by registration yaw; add model world x/base/z

registration.label: 组团候选定位·相对布局待核 · 非实测
registration.uncertainty: 模型办公→中住宅→SE住宅中心距27.02/30.5，源地图83.47/52.26m，相对布局矛盾；办公/住宅宽度比也不一致。；三中心整体最小二乘scale2.3300产生RMS9.87m且压港沙路与沿江大道，拒用。；当前scale1.4061的保守完整组团不压源邻楼或机动车道，但塔中心误差30.07/16.00/24.32m，应标“组团候选定位·相对布局待核”。；OFFICE/RESIDENTIAL MID/RIGHT可语义分离，但共享院落、塔基与桥廊不能无缝随三塔分别搬动；未自行重做裙房。；只去SITE local paving/SITE paving joints。4种有照片形态依据的前场铺装/花池/通用绿化保留，已另查全部源背景楼和道路均无相交。

method: Read both retained GLBs directly, including meshopt-compressed buffers and normalized quantized accessors.
Apply each node.getWorldMatrix() to every POSITION vertex; triangleIndex is local to its material primitive.
Collect all triangles with at least one vertex source Y <= 1.01; every proposed surface has Y <= .1004107811, so triangles above this ceiling cannot intersect it.
Identify real upward faces by cross-product normal, then connect shared edges. Do not interpret merged node names or full material AABBs as walkable surfaces.

Clip source triangles to candidate XZ rectangles using Sutherland-Hodgman. Report boundary-only contact separately from positive-area overlap. Underlay plane is below the minimum Y of every triangle in its footprint.
Boundary polygon coordinates are rounded to 1e-7 source units for topology grouping; original floating-point face bounds, elevations and passage corners are retained.

interpretation: Export merges by material. Node PODIUM 1 open-court slabs contains repeated storey slabs and many low bases; its name is not evidence of a single ground forecourt.
Two real low inner-street capsule surfaces are present at source Y about .05495; two Light stone paving boxes, including east passage, have identical top geometry in both LODs at .100410781098.
The apparent circular front court is three narrow decorative annuli of radius about 4.7, 5.0 and 6.8, each about .07 wide. There is no retained solid circular forecourt surface beneath them.
East passage already contains/abuts staircase geometry near X 33..35.45, Z 10.44..18.93. Only its actual forward boundary at Z 23.0001641815 is used for the proposed join.

A broad ramp directly forward across X33.2..36.8 would intersect the retained inner decorative rings while descending. Use the audited narrow ramp outside the two inner rings, then spread a low support surface below all annuli.
A road connection on the +X side of the passage is not supported: the model retains plinth/storefront/frame geometry between the passage and the east outside face.
